title: Determinants of gender discrimination by teachers: Evidence from an online experiment
title_zh: 教师性别歧视的决定因素：来自在线实验的证据
title_primary: 教师性别歧视的决定因素：来自在线实验的证据
title_secondary: Determinants of gender discrimination by teachers: Evidence from an online experiment
authors: Marion Monnet, Etienne Dagorn, Philippe Colo
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper examines whether teachers’ gender biases stem from discrimination, and focuses on two of its potential drivers: gender preferences and beliefs. In an online experiment, 1840 teachers evaluated fictitious transcripts with randomized gender information. Preferences are measured via dictator games, and beliefs through an Implicit Association Test. While teachers show no gender preferences, they do hold gender beliefs. Analyzing 19,000 transcript evaluations, we find no evidence of gender-based discrimination. Our findings suggest that when only exposed to student gender, even teachers with biased beliefs do not discriminate.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了教师性别偏见是否源于歧视，并聚焦于其两个潜在驱动因素：性别偏好与性别信念。在一项在线实验中，1840名教师评估了随机化性别信息的虚构成绩单。偏好通过独裁者游戏测量，信念则通过内隐联想测试评估。尽管教师未表现出性别偏好，但他们确实持有性别信念。分析19,000份成绩单评估结果，我们未发现基于性别的歧视证据。研究结果表明，当仅接触学生性别信息时，即使持有偏见信念的教师也不会进行歧视。

title: Europe’s federated democratic learning state
title_zh: 欧洲联邦民主学习型国家
title_primary: 欧洲联邦民主学习型国家
title_secondary: Europe’s federated democratic learning state
official: 官方在线 2026-09-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Europe is moving towards invoice-level electronic VAT reporting. This column argues that, with AI-assisted processing of the information contained in electronic VAT invoices, the tax system can become not just a compliance and revenue-raising instrument, but a protected intelligence map of the economy. Putting a public-stewarded VAT-derived knowledge graph, combined with AI, to work can fundamentally reshape the role of the state and, hence, redefine the boundaries of the firm. For Europe, a unique opportunity emerges to evolve the Single Market to become an intelligence and orchestration platform of a modern state that leans on real-time, high-authority administrative data.
abstract_zh: 欧洲正迈向发票级电子增值税报告。本文认为，借助人工智能处理电子增值税发票所含信息，税收体系不仅能成为合规与增收工具，更能演变为受保护的经济情报图谱。将公共管理的增值税衍生知识图谱与人工智能相结合并付诸应用，可从根本上重塑国家角色，进而重新界定企业的边界。对欧洲而言，一个独特机遇浮现：将单一市场升级为依托实时、高权威行政数据的现代国家情报与协调平台。

title: AI in a Fragmenting World
title_zh: 碎片化世界中的AI
title_primary: 碎片化世界中的AI
title_secondary: AI in a Fragmenting World
authors: Barry Eichengreen, Jingyuan(George) Cui, Asmaa El Ganainy, Yevgeniya Korniyenko, Elyad Shojaei 等
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We link two global trends—AI and geoeconomic fragmentation—asking how fragmentation affects the international diffusion of AI, the magnitude of gains, and their distribution across economies. We ask these questions in general but also with a focus on the MENAP economies.
abstract_zh: 我们将两大全球趋势——人工智能与地缘经济碎片化——联系起来，探讨碎片化如何影响人工智能的国际扩散、收益规模及其在各经济体间的分布。我们不仅从一般层面提出这些问题，还特别聚焦于中东、北非及巴基斯坦（MENAP）经济体。

title: JUE Insight: Breaking ground: Can refund bonuses solve the holdout problem?
title_zh: 洞察专栏：破土动工：退款奖金能否解决“钉子户”问题？
title_primary: 洞察专栏：破土动工：退款奖金能否解决“钉子户”问题？
title_secondary: JUE Insight: Breaking ground: Can refund bonuses solve the holdout problem?
authors: Timothy N. Cason, Alex Tabarrok, Robertas Zubrickas
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The holdout problem presents a pervasive challenge in situations that require the assembly of independently controlled assets, where due to complementarity the combined whole is worth more than the sum of its parts. One avenue for addressing holdout problems involves contingent contracts, where agreements are conditional upon reaching a predetermined threshold. This paper reports an experiment to investigate a new refund bonus contingent mechanism, in which asset owners who agree to participate (e.g., sell their asset) receive a bonus payment if the required threshold for project success is not met. The refund bonus eliminates failure equilibria and improves the frequency of successfully reaching the threshold in the symmetric mixed strategy equilibrium. In the experiment, individual asset holders choose each round whether to accept an offer to sell. Multiple owners must accept for the (contingent) sale to materialize, and holdout owners who do not sell can earn more, so the game has the strategic incentives of a volunteer’s dilemma. The data show that the bonus mechanism increases agreements to sell, the frequency of successful projects, and efficiency. By the second half of the experimental sessions, the total number of sales is 35 percent higher and the threshold is met nearly twice as often with the bonus than without.
abstract_zh: 搁置问题在需要整合独立控制资产的场景中普遍存在，由于互补性，整体价值超过各部分之和。解决搁置问题的一个途径是采用条件合同，即协议以达成预定门槛为条件。本文通过实验研究了一种新的退款奖金条件机制，在该机制中，同意参与（如出售其资产）的资产所有者，若项目成功所需门槛未达成，将获得一笔奖金支付。退款奖金消除了失败均衡，并在对称混合策略均衡中提高了成功达到门槛的频率。实验中，个体资产持有者每轮选择是否接受出售要约。多个所有者必须接受才能使（条件）销售实现，而未出售的搁置所有者能获得更多收益，因此该博弈具有志愿者困境的战略激励。数据显示，奖金机制增加了出售协议的数量、成功项目的频率及效率。在实验后半段，有奖金时的总销售数量比无奖金时高出35%，达到门槛的频率几乎是后者的两倍。

title: The Limits of Government Outsourcing: Property Tax Re-Assessments in India
title_zh: 政府外包的局限性：印度财产税重新评估
title_primary: 政府外包的局限性：印度财产税重新评估
title_secondary: The Limits of Government Outsourcing: Property Tax Re-Assessments in India
authors: Esther Duflo, Rema Hanna, Benjamin A. Olken, Shreya Tandon
official: 官方在线 2026-08-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Theories of outsourcing often presume that private firms are more efficient producers of goods and services, but that contracting frictions mean that firms do not internalize the government's objective function. But perhaps, for some tasks, the government can actually be more productively efficient? We study this question through an experiment in Chennai, India, where the government randomly selected neighborhoods to have property tax assessments determined by private firms contracted by the government, rather than government tax inspectors. We show that inspections by government tax inspectors yielded almost double the increase in tax revenue as those done by private firms. They were also more accurate, as judged by comparing new assessments to independent assessments done by third-party surveyors we hired. Difficulties contracting with the government discouraged many competent firms from bidding. Perhaps as a result, government inspectors had higher skills and put in more effort than the workers at the private firms. Importantly, the government inspectors also had more authority to enter properties, which may be hard to transfer even to higher quality firms. The results suggest that the limits to government outsourcing may go beyond multitasking issues.
abstract_zh: 外包理论通常假定私营企业在商品和服务生产方面更具效率，但契约摩擦意味着企业并不内化政府的目标函数。然而，或许在某些任务上，政府实际上可能更具生产效率？我们通过在印度金奈进行的一项实验来研究这一问题，实验中政府随机选择社区，由政府签约的私营企业而非政府税务检查员来评估房产税。我们显示，政府税务检查员的检查所带来的税收增长几乎是私营企业的两倍。根据我们聘请的第三方调查员进行的独立评估比较，政府检查员的评估也更为准确。与政府签约的困难使许多有能力的公司不愿投标。或许正因如此，政府检查员比私营企业的工人拥有更高的技能并投入了更多努力。重要的是，政府检查员还拥有更多进入房产的权力，这种权力即使对更高质量的企业也可能难以转移。结果表明，政府外包的局限性可能超越多任务处理问题。

title: Influencer Cartels
title_zh: 网红卡特尔
title_primary: 网红卡特尔
title_secondary: Influencer Cartels
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-05 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Social media influencers account for a growing share of marketing worldwide. We demonstrate the existence of a novel form of market failure in the advertising market: influencer cartels, where groups of influencers collude to increase their advertising revenue by inflating their engagement. Our theoretical model shows that influencer cartels can improve consumer welfare if they expand social media engagement to the target audience, or reduce welfare if they divert engagement to less relevant audiences. Drawing on the model’s insights, we empirically examine influencer cartels using novel datasets and machine learning tools, and derive policy implications.
abstract_zh: 社交媒体影响者在全球营销中的占比日益增长。我们揭示了广告市场中一种新型市场失灵现象：影响者卡特尔，即影响者群体串通一气，通过夸大其互动量来增加广告收入。我们的理论模型表明，若影响者卡特尔能将社交媒体互动扩展至目标受众，则可提升消费者福利；反之，若将互动转移至相关性较低的受众，则可能降低福利。基于模型洞见，我们运用新颖数据集和机器学习工具对影响者卡特尔进行实证研究，并得出政策启示。

title: Incomplete Information and Self-Fulfilling Inflation Dynamics—Lucas meets Keynes
title_zh: 不完全信息与自我实现的通胀动态——卢卡斯遇见凯恩斯
title_primary: 不完全信息与自我实现的通胀动态——卢卡斯遇见凯恩斯
title_secondary: Incomplete Information and Self-Fulfilling Inflation Dynamics—Lucas meets Keynes
authors: Jess Benhabib, Pengfei Wang, Yi Wen
official: 官方在线 2026-08-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper incorporates the Lucas (1973) island model into a standard DSGE framework. It demonstrates that self-fulfilling stochastic inflation equilibria, which are driven by intrinsic uncertainty or pure sentiments, can exist under rational expectations. Furthermore, it shows that these sentiment-driven stochastic equilibria exhibit monetary non-neutrality, even when the fundamental equilibrium is unique and monetarily neutral. As the aggregate price or inflation rate can appear to fluctuate independently of the money supply, our model explains the complex relationship between inflation and the money supply in the real world, where the basic quantity theory of money often seems invalid.
abstract_zh: 本文将Lucas（1973）岛屿模型融入标准DSGE框架，证明在理性预期下，由内在不确定性或纯粹情绪驱动的自我实现随机通胀均衡可能存在。进一步，本文表明，即使基础均衡唯一且货币中性，这些情绪驱动的随机均衡仍表现出货币非中性。由于总体价格或通胀率看似独立于货币供应波动，本模型解释了现实世界中通胀与货币供应之间复杂的关系，其中基本货币数量论往往显得失效。

title: Deep Learning for Solving Economic Models
title_zh: 深度学习求解经济模型
title_primary: 深度学习求解经济模型
title_secondary: Deep Learning for Solving Economic Models
official: 来源期次 2026-09-01 · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: The ongoing revolution in deep learning is reshaping research across many fields, including economics. Its effects are especially clear in solving dynamic economic models. These models often lack closed-form solutions, so economists have long relied on numerical methods such as value function iteration, perturbation, and projection techniques. Unfortunately, these approaches suffer from the curse of dimensionality, which makes global solutions computationally infeasible as the number of state variables increases. Deep learning offers a different approach: flexible tools that solve dynamic economic models by minimizing residuals in equilibrium conditions, and that can handle high-dimensional problems. This development promises to broaden the scope of quantitative economics. I illustrate the approach using the neoclassical growth model.
abstract_zh: 深度学习的持续革命正在重塑包括经济学在内的众多领域的研究格局。其在动态经济模型求解方面的作用尤为显著。由于这类模型通常缺乏闭式解，经济学家长期以来依赖数值方法，如值函数迭代、摄动法和投影技术。遗憾的是，这些方法受困于维度灾难——随着状态变量数量的增加，全局解在计算上变得不可行。深度学习提供了一种不同的路径：通过最小化均衡条件残差来求解动态经济模型的灵活工具，能够处理高维问题。这一发展有望拓宽定量经济学的应用范围。本文以新古典增长模型为例阐释该方法。

title: The Environmental Bias of Corporate Income Taxation
title_zh: 企业所得税的环境偏向
title_primary: 企业所得税的环境偏向
title_secondary: The Environmental Bias of Corporate Income Taxation
authors: Iovino, Luigi, Martin, Thorsten, Sauvagnat, Julien
official: 卷期日期 2026-09-01 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the relationship between corporate income taxation and carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions in the U.S. We show that CO2-intensive firms benefit more from the tax advantage of debt, and pay lower income taxes on their capital income. Building on these new facts, we provide evidence that a cut in the corporate income tax rate leads to a larger expansion of clean firms. We develop a multi-sector general equilibrium model that accounts for our evidence and quantify the impact of corporate tax reforms on aggregate emissions. A policy that eliminates the tax advantage of debt could reduce aggregate emissions without affecting GDP.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国企业所得税与二氧化碳排放之间的关系。研究表明，二氧化碳密集型企业在债务税收优惠中获益更多，且其资本收入缴纳的所得税更低。基于这些新发现，我们提供了证据表明企业所得税税率下调会促使清洁企业实现更大规模的扩张。我们构建了一个多部门一般均衡模型来解释这一现象，并量化了企业税制改革对总排放量的影响。一项消除债务税收优惠的政策可在不影响GDP的情况下减少总排放量。

title: How Costly Are Cartels?
title_zh: 卡特尔代价有多高？
title_primary: 卡特尔代价有多高？
title_secondary: How Costly Are Cartels?
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the cost of cartels in an oligopoly model with het- erogeneous firms, endogenous markups, and collusion. Cartels can amplify or dampen misallocation, by charging supracompetitive markups and reallocating demand towards non-colluding firms. Using French micro data, our calibrated model suggests that cartels operating in the most productive industries may decrease aggregate productivity by up to 0.4% and welfare by up to 0.7%. We also find that standard competitive oligopoly models may understate the cost of markups by about 20%.
abstract_zh: 本文研究异质性企业、内生加成率与合谋行为并存寡头模型中的卡特尔成本。卡特尔通过收取超竞争加成率并将需求重新分配给非合谋企业，可能加剧或缓解资源错配。基于法国微观数据的校准模型表明，在最具生产率的行业中运营的卡特尔可能导致全要素生产率下降0.4%，福利损失高达0.7%。我们还发现，标准竞争性寡头模型可能低估加成率成本约20%。

title: Consumption responses to a major minimum wage increase: Evidence from Spain
title_zh: 最低工资大幅上调的消费反应：来自西班牙的证据
title_primary: 最低工资大幅上调的消费反应：来自西班牙的证据
title_secondary: Consumption responses to a major minimum wage increase: Evidence from Spain
authors: Ignacio González, Hector Sala, Pedro Trivin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper examines the effects of minimum wage increases on household consumption, focusing on Spain’s 2019 reform, which raised the wage floor by an unprecedented 22.3 percent in a low-inflation environment. Using high-frequency confidential card-based transaction data, we exploit geographic variation in exposure to the reform. We find that municipalities more exposed to the reform increased consumption by 4.5 percent relative to less-exposed municipalities, with the largest gains concentrated in categories such as electronics, leisure, and spending at restaurants and hotels. We complement this analysis with household-level evidence from the Spanish Household Budget Survey. Consistent with the transaction data, affected households increased their consumption substantially—by 10.2 percent—and exhibited a marginal propensity to consume of 0.8, with spending gains also concentrated in discretionary categories. Combining evidence from both sources, our findings are suggestive of sizable local demand spillovers. Firm-level sectoral evidence further suggests that the costs of the reform were primarily absorbed through the exit of less productive firms rather than through broad employment or price adjustments.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了最低工资上调对家庭消费的影响，重点关注西班牙2019年的改革，该改革在低通胀环境下将最低工资标准前所未有地提高了22.3%。利用高频机密银行卡交易数据，我们利用各地区对改革暴露程度的地理差异进行分析。研究发现，相对于暴露程度较低的地区，暴露程度较高的城市消费增长了4.5%，其中增长最为显著的类别集中在电子产品、休闲以及餐饮和酒店消费。我们通过西班牙家庭预算调查中的家庭层面证据对这一分析进行了补充。与交易数据一致，受影响家庭的消费显著增加了10.2%，边际消费倾向为0.8，且支出增长同样集中在非必需品类。结合两个来源的证据，我们的研究结果表明存在显著的本地需求溢出效应。企业层面的行业证据进一步表明，改革的成本主要通过低生产率企业的退出而非广泛的就业或价格调整来吸收。

title: Resilience by Design: What Role Can Policy Frameworks Play in the Middle East and Central Asia?
title_zh: 韧性设计：政策框架在中东和中亚地区的作用
title_primary: 韧性设计：政策框架在中东和中亚地区的作用
title_secondary: Resilience by Design: What Role Can Policy Frameworks Play in the Middle East and Central Asia?
authors: Hasan Dudu & Mr. Troy D Matheson & Mr. Dirk V Muir & Karmen Naidoo & Salem M Nechi & Mr. Pedro C Rodriguez
official: 官方在线 2026-07-03 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: The changing global economic landscape is likely to expose the Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan (MENAP) and Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA) regions to more frequent external shocks, putting a premium on resilient and flexible macroeconomic policy frameworks. By using empirical analysis and model-based scenarios, this paper highlights the important roles of policy frameworks in stabilizing MENAP and CCA economies against adverse global shocks. Two messages stand out from the analysis. First, as countries make progress toward diversifying their exports and deepening domestic financial markets, credible inflation-targeting monetary policy regimes that allow greater exchange rate flexibility could enable faster adjustment to adverse global shocks. Second, adopting strong fiscal rules could help better anchor long-term expectations, reduce risk premiums, and help support countercyclical fiscal responses.
abstract_zh: 不断变化的全球经济格局可能使中东、北非和巴基斯坦（MENAP）以及高加索和中亚（CCA）地区面临更频繁的外部冲击，从而凸显了具有韧性和灵活性的宏观经济政策框架的重要性。通过实证分析和基于模型的场景模拟，本文强调了政策框架在稳定MENAP和CCA经济体以应对不利全球冲击中的关键作用。分析得出两个核心结论：第一，随着各国在出口多元化和深化国内金融市场方面取得进展，采用可信的通胀目标制货币政策框架并允许更大汇率灵活性，能够加速对不利全球冲击的调整；第二，实施强有力的财政规则有助于更好地锚定长期预期、降低风险溢价，并支持逆周期财政应对措施。

title: Beyond substitution: the moderating effect of the minimum wage on robot-labour dynamics in China
title_zh: 超越替代：最低工资对中国机器人-劳动力动态关系的调节效应
title_primary: 超越替代：最低工资对中国机器人-劳动力动态关系的调节效应
title_secondary: Beyond substitution: the moderating effect of the minimum wage on robot-labour dynamics in China
authors: Junpeng Di, Hao Hui, Haoyu Wang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-06 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study examines the moderating effect of the minimum wage on the relationship between industrial robots and labour mobility in China. Using provincial-industrial panel data from 2006–2019, combining China’s industrial database and IFR robot data, we analyse patterns of labour mobility at both regional and industry levels. To ensure the robustness of the results, we discuss potential collinearity between robot penetration and the minimum wage, as well as the persistence of the relation of the baseline results. Our findings reveal that the minimum wage negatively moderates the positive effect of robots on regional labour mobility while amplifying their impact on inter-industry labour reallocation. Heterogeneity analysis shows these effects are stronger in regions with lower education levels and higher employment rates. Although the minimum wage exhibits no significant lagged effects on regional labour mobility, it demonstrates persistent effects on industrial labour mobility. Long-term analysis further indicates that the minimum wage amplifies robots’ negative influence on regional labour flows while enhancing industrial labour reallocation. These findings suggest the need for coordinated policies that consider both automation trends and regional labour market characteristics when setting the minimum wage.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了最低工资对中国工业机器人影响劳动力流动的调节效应。基于2006-2019年省级-行业面板数据，结合中国工业数据库与国际机器人联合会（IFR）机器人数据，我们从区域和行业两个层面分析了劳动力流动模式。为确保结果稳健性，我们探讨了机器人渗透率与最低工资之间可能存在的多重共线性问题，以及基准结果关系的持续性。研究发现：最低工资对机器人促进区域劳动力流动的正向效应具有负向调节作用，同时强化了机器人对跨行业劳动力再配置的影响。异质性分析表明，在受教育水平较低、就业率较高的地区，上述调节效应更为显著。尽管最低工资对区域劳动力流动未呈现显著滞后效应，但其对行业间劳动力流动具有持续影响。长期分析进一步显示，最低工资会放大机器人对区域劳动力流动的抑制作用，同时增强行业间劳动力再配置效应。这些发现表明，在制定最低工资标准时，需要统筹考虑自动化发展趋势与区域劳动力市场特征，实施协调性政策。

title: The Missing Surprise: Transmission Protection in Central Bank Announcements
title_zh: 缺失的意外：央行公告中的传导保护

authors: Christoph Grosse Steffen, Daniel Lewis, Stéphane Lhuissier
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Central bank communications frequently contain information about financial-market backstops that affect monetary policy transmission. We identify these transmission protection surprises in the euro area, alongside policy stance and central bank information surprises, by exploiting heteroskedasticity in minute-by-minute asset price movements. Unlike standard factor models, our approach allows active policy dimensions and their impacts to vary across events. Event-specific decompositions quantify the narrative record and reveal substantial heterogeneity of effects across announcements. We show that transmission protection is a distinct dimension of central bank announcements, with financial-market effects separate from both policy stance and information shocks.
abstract_zh: 央行沟通中频繁包含影响货币政策传导的金融市场兜底信息。我们利用欧元区资产价格分钟级波动的异方差性，在识别政策立场与央行信息冲击的同时，识别出这些传导保护意外。与标准因子模型不同，我们的方法允许政策维度及其影响在不同事件中动态变化。基于事件特定分解的量化叙事记录显示，不同公告的影响存在显著异质性。研究表明，传导保护是央行公告的独立维度，其金融市场效应与政策立场冲击及信息冲击均存在差异。

official: 官方在线 2026-06-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study the political economy of carbon taxes when neoclassical consumers take all other agents' emissions as given and socially responsible consumers internalize damages in a group-rule-utilitarian way, taking neoclassical consumers' behavior as given. We characterize political equilibrium taxes with a focus on deviations from first-best Pigouvian taxation. Welfare falls further if arguments on moral obligations to reduce carbon footprints polarize the debate in society. Finally, we present survey evidence that supports our theory: social responsibility correlates with lower consumption of brown goods, higher preferred carbon taxes, and support for moral arguments.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了在两类消费者并存情境下碳税的政治经济学：新古典消费者将其他行为主体的排放视为既定，而具有社会责任感的消费者则以群体规则功利主义方式内化损害，并将新古典消费者的行为视为既定。我们刻画了政治均衡税收的特征，重点关注其与最优庇古税的偏离。若关于减少碳足迹的道德义务论据加剧社会辩论的两极分化，社会福利将进一步下降。最后，我们提供的调查证据支持了理论：社会责任感与棕色商品消费减少、更高碳税偏好及对道德论据的支持呈正相关。

abstract: I have never met Jim Brander in person, yet he played an outsized role in my early career. The following story illustrates how we academic economists, through our research and publications, can have an influence on the lives of others whom we never know and might never meet.

title: Political Economy of Environmental Policy Under Trade
title_zh: 贸易条件下环境政策的政治经济学
title_primary: 贸易条件下环境政策的政治经济学
title_secondary: Political Economy of Environmental Policy Under Trade
official: 官方在线 2026-06-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The link between environment and trade has long been the subject of intense policy debate. This study reviews the existing literature and addresses key gaps. We develop a unified framework that incorporates environmental externalities (local versus global), abatement, political competition, and trade. The model shows how producer and consumer/environmentalist lobbying incentives over pollution stringency interact, and how these incentives vary with the nature and magnitude of environmental externalities, the structure of environmental agreements (unilateral versus multilateral), and trade regimes. It also highlights the roles of abatement and terms‐of‐trade effects in shaping the equilibrium outcomes. In a large open economy, cooperative policy internalises the costs of emission leakage induced by lobbying, making it more welfare‐improving than noncooperative policy. Producer and consumer lobbying generally exert countervailing pressures, with their relative influence determined by the weights the government assigns to each group.
abstract_zh: 环境与贸易之间的联系长期以来一直是政策辩论的焦点。本研究回顾了现有文献，并填补了关键空白。我们构建了一个统一的分析框架，将环境外部性（本地与全球）、减排措施、政治竞争和贸易纳入其中。该模型揭示了生产者和消费者/环保主义者围绕污染严格程度的游说激励如何相互作用，以及这些激励如何随环境外部性的性质与规模、环境协议的结构（单边与多边）以及贸易体制而变化。模型还强调了减排效应和贸易条件效应在塑造均衡结果中的作用。在大型开放经济体中，合作性政策内化了游说引发的排放泄漏成本，因此比非合作性政策更能提升福利。生产者和消费者的游说通常产生相互抵消的压力，其相对影响力取决于政府赋予各群体的权重。

title: What Explains International Interest Rate Co‐Movement?
title_zh: 什么解释了国际利率的联动性？
title_primary: 什么解释了国际利率的联动性？
title_secondary: What Explains International Interest Rate Co‐Movement?
official: 官方在线 2026-06-08 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The international co‐movement of interest rates reflects correlated business‐cycle fluctuations, largely driven by demand shocks. Monetary policy in advanced economies follows domestic mandates—inflation and the output gap—and does not respond to foreign policy shocks. We derive this result from a Bayesian structural panel vector autoregression with informative priors, homogeneity restrictions on contemporaneous relations, a hierarchical Minnesota prior with cross‐sectional shrinkage, and a factor structure for structural shocks.
abstract_zh: 国际利率的联动反映了商业周期波动的相关性，这主要由需求冲击驱动。发达经济体的货币政策遵循国内任务——通胀和产出缺口——并不对外国政策冲击作出反应。我们通过一个带有信息先验、同期关系同质性限制、具有横截面收缩的分层明尼苏达先验以及结构冲击因子结构的贝叶斯结构面板向量自回归模型得出这一结论。

title: Climate Policies, Macroprudential Regulation, and the Welfare Cost of Business Cycles
title_zh: 气候政策、宏观审慎监管与经济周期福利成本
title_primary: 气候政策、宏观审慎监管与经济周期福利成本
title_secondary: Climate Policies, Macroprudential Regulation, and the Welfare Cost of Business Cycles
authors: BARBARA ANNICCHIARICO, MARCO CARLI, FRANCESCA DILUISO
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-06-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study how alternative carbon pricing policies, namely carbon taxes and cap‐and‐trade schemes, affect macroeconomic dynamics and the welfare cost of business cycles in a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium model with financial frictions (FFs) and pollution externalities. FFs play a critical role in shaping how business cycle shocks propagate across carbon pricing regimes. We find that, with financial frictions, welfare costs are generally lower under cap‐and‐trade schemes than under carbon taxes, as procyclical permit prices dampen financial amplification. The welfare gap between the two policies narrows as credit markets become more efficient or countercyclical macroprudential regulation weakens shock transmission.
abstract_zh: 本文在包含金融摩擦与污染外部性的动态随机一般均衡模型中，研究了两种替代性碳定价政策——碳税与总量控制与交易机制——如何影响宏观经济动态及经济周期的福利成本。金融摩擦在塑造经济周期冲击跨碳定价机制传导路径中发挥关键作用。研究发现，在存在金融摩擦的情况下，总量控制与交易机制下的福利成本通常低于碳税政策，原因在于其顺周期性的排放配额价格能够抑制金融加速器效应。随着信贷市场效率提升或逆周期宏观审慎监管削弱冲击传导机制，两种政策间的福利差距将逐步收窄。

title: Optimal Tests Following Sequential Experiments
title_zh: 序贯实验后的最优检验
title_primary: 序贯实验后的最优检验
title_secondary: Optimal Tests Following Sequential Experiments
official: 官方在线 2026-06-02 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Recent years have seen tremendous advances in the theory and application of sequential experiments. While these experiments are not always designed with hypothesis testing in mind, researchers may still be interested in performing tests after the experiment is completed. The purpose of this paper is to aid in the development of optimal tests for sequential experiments by analyzing their asymptotic properties. Our key finding is that the asymptotic power function of any test can be matched by a test in a limit experiment where a Gaussian process is observed for each treatment, and inference is made for the drifts of these processes. This result has important implications, including a powerful sufficiency result: any candidate test only needs to rely on a fixed set of statistics, regardless of the type of sequential experiment. These statistics are the number of times each treatment has been sampled by the end of the experiment, along with final value of the score (for parametric models) or efficient influence function (for non-parametric models) process for each treatment. We then characterize asymptotically optimal tests under various restrictions such as unbiasedness, α-spending constraints etc. Finally, we apply our our results to three key classes of sequential experiments: costly sampling, group sequential trials, and bandit experiments, and show how optimal inference can be conducted in these scenarios.
abstract_zh: 近年来，序贯实验的理论与应用取得了巨大进展。尽管这些实验并非总是以假设检验为设计初衷，但研究者仍可能在实验结束后有兴趣进行检验。本文旨在通过分析序贯实验的渐近性质，助力开发最优检验方法。我们的核心发现是，任何检验的渐近功效函数都可以通过一个极限实验中的检验来匹配，在该极限实验中，每种处理观测到一个高斯过程，并针对这些过程的漂移进行推断。这一结果具有重要含义，包括一个强有力的充分性结论：任何候选检验仅需依赖一组固定的统计量，无论序贯实验的类型如何。这些统计量包括实验结束时每种处理被采样的次数，以及每种处理得分（对于参数模型）或有效影响函数（对于非参数模型）过程的最终值。随后，我们在无偏性、α支出约束等各种限制条件下刻画了渐近最优检验。最后，我们将结果应用于三类关键的序贯实验：成本采样、组序贯试验和老虎机实验，并展示了在这些情境下如何进行最优推断。

title: Realtor Forecasting Accuracy on Homebuyer Preferences for Energy Efficiency
title_zh: 房地产经纪人关于购房者能效偏好预测的准确性
title_primary: 房地产经纪人关于购房者能效偏好预测的准确性
title_secondary: Realtor Forecasting Accuracy on Homebuyer Preferences for Energy Efficiency
authors: Erik Gråd, Anna Kristina Edenbrandt, Alexander Eriksson, Emilia Mattsson, Jens Rommel
official: 官方在线 2026-05-26 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Residential energy use is a major contributor to total energy consumption and CO 2 emissions, and energy costs can take up high shares of household spending. In this context, we make three contributions to the literature. First, using a discrete choice experiment with 1,389 prospective homebuyers in Sweden, we investigate how homebuyers account for energy efficiency of buildings compared to other attributes when looking for a new home. Second, we elicit forecasts from a sample of 252 realtors whom we ask to predict homebuyers’ preferences, allowing us to shed light on the role these important mediators play regarding energy efficiency in the housing market. Third, we estimate how providing prior information on homebuyers’ choices affects realtors’ forecasting accuracy. For homebuyers, we find that energy efficiency ranks low overall. Realtors’ forecasting accuracy is lower for the energy efficiency attribute. Providing realtors with more prior information has sizeable positive effects on forecasting accuracy, and information also affects self-reported difficulty of and confidence in the forecasts.
abstract_zh: 住宅能源使用是总能源消耗和二氧化碳排放的主要来源，能源成本在家庭支出中占据较高比例。在此背景下，我们为相关文献做出三项贡献。首先，通过对瑞典1389名潜在购房者进行离散选择实验，我们研究了购房者在寻找新住房时如何权衡建筑能效与其他属性。其次，我们收集了252名房地产经纪人的预测样本，要求他们预测购房者的偏好，从而揭示这些重要中介在住房市场能效方面所扮演的角色。第三，我们评估了向房地产经纪人提供购房者选择的先验信息对其预测准确性的影响。研究发现，购房者对能效属性的整体重视程度较低。房地产经纪人对能效属性的预测准确性也较低。向房地产经纪人提供更多先验信息能显著提升预测准确性，同时信息还会影响其自我报告的预测难度和信心水平。

title: The depth and breadth of capitalism at the Cape
title_zh: 开普地区资本主义的深度与广度
title_primary: 开普地区资本主义的深度与广度
title_secondary: The depth and breadth of capitalism at the Cape
official: 官方在线 2026-05-24 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Limited liability company legislation was introduced to the Cape Colony in 1861. An amendment in 1892 led to wider adoption, expanding and diversifying the capital market. Using novel data from the Cape Joint Stock Archive between 1892 and 1902, this paper examines who invested, where capital flowed, and how these patterns shaped firm outcomes across Southern Africa. We show the geographic breadth of the capital market, revealing how shareholders and company operations were dispersed far beyond the Cape. The depth measures shareholders' occupational diversity using Historical International Standard Classifications of Occupations (HISCO) and paid‐up capital. We find investor participation varied systematically by occupation, industry, and location. These preferences influenced firm survival and spatial organization. Shareholders invested at considerable distances from company operations or registered offices, facilitating early forms of managerial separation. Paid‐up capital, a proxy for shareholder depth, was associated with survival, with smaller firms exhibiting shorter lifespans. Formation and failure were closely tied to both local and external economic shocks, underscoring the integration of the Cape economy into wider business cycles. Finally, the Cape illustrates how early commercial law and the organization of private capital may have shaped longer‐run regional economic structures.
abstract_zh: 1861年，开普殖民地引入了有限责任公司立法。1892年的一项修正案推动了该制度的更广泛采用，从而扩大并丰富了资本市场。本文利用1892年至1902年间开普联合股票档案的新数据，考察了谁在投资、资本流向何处，以及这些模式如何影响南部非洲企业的经营成果。我们展示了资本市场的地理广度，揭示了股东和公司运营如何远远超出开普地区。通过历史国际标准职业分类（HISCO）和实缴资本，我们衡量了股东职业多样性的深度。研究发现，投资者的参与因职业、行业和地理位置而呈现系统性差异。这些偏好影响了企业的生存和空间组织。股东在距离公司运营或注册办事处相当远的地方进行投资，促进了早期形式的管理分离。实缴资本作为股东深度的代理变量，与企业的生存相关，规模较小的公司寿命较短。企业的成立与倒闭与本地及外部经济冲击密切相关，凸显了开普经济与更广泛商业周期的融合。最后，开普的案例表明，早期商业法和私人资本的组织方式可能塑造了长期区域经济结构。

title: US‐China trade war: Heterogeneous effects on the US consumer
title_zh: 中美贸易战：对美国消费者的异质性影响
title_primary: 中美贸易战：对美国消费者的异质性影响
title_secondary: US‐China trade war: Heterogeneous effects on the US consumer
official: 官方在线 2026-05-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper meticulously investigates how the US‐China trade war of 2018–19 affected nondurable consumption patterns for households across the United States. Using highly granular NielsenIQ barcode scanner data, we find that a 1 percentage point (pp) increase in a county's tariff exposure growth was associated with a decrease in nondurable consumption growth ranging between 0.593 pp and 2.163 pp. Notably, this relationship existed for employed households but not for those without employment, and it was not confined to those working in manufacturing and farming. Additionally, households with children had lower consumption growth as tariff exposure increased, and the relationship was more negative for larger households. Regionally, Midwest households were more negatively affected than those in the New England, Pacific, and South Atlantic states. The relationship between household consumption growth and tariff exposure growth was similar for both more‐ and less‐durable goods. These findings have significant implications for understanding the economic and social impacts of trade wars on household consumption patterns.
abstract_zh: 本文细致考察了2018-19年中美贸易战如何影响美国各地家庭的非耐用品消费模式。利用高度细化的尼尔森IQ条形码扫描数据，我们发现，一个县关税暴露增长每增加1个百分点（pp），其非耐用品消费增长将下降0.593至2.163个百分点。值得注意的是，这一关系存在于就业家庭中，而非失业家庭，并且不仅限于制造业和农业从业者。此外，有子女的家庭在关税暴露增加时消费增长更低，且这一负向关系在规模较大的家庭中更为显著。从区域来看，中西部家庭受到的负面影响大于新英格兰、太平洋沿岸及南大西洋各州。家庭消费增长与关税暴露增长之间的关系在耐用品与非耐用品之间相似。这些发现对于理解贸易战对家庭消费模式的经济和社会影响具有重要意义。

title: 构建中国公共管理自主知识体系的系统性思维和建构性路径
title_zh: 构建中国公共管理自主知识体系的系统性思维和建构性路径
title_primary: 构建中国公共管理自主知识体系的系统性思维和建构性路径

title: Incorporating Micro Data into Differentiated Products Demand Estimation with PyBLP
title_zh: 将微观数据纳入PyBLP差异化产品需求估计
title_primary: 将微观数据纳入PyBLP差异化产品需求估计
title_secondary: Incorporating Micro Data into Differentiated Products Demand Estimation with PyBLP
official: 官方在线 2025-01-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We delineate a general framework for incorporating many types of micro data from summary statistics to full surveys of selected consumers into Berry, Levinsohn, and Pakes (1995)-style estimates of differentiated products demand systems. We extend recommended practices for BLP estimation in Conlon and Gortmaker (2020) to the case with micro data and implement them in our open-source package PyBLP. Monte Carlo experiments and empirical examples suggest that incorporating micro data can substantially improve the finite sample performance of the BLP estimator, particularly when using well-targeted summary statistics or “optimal micro moments” that we derive and show how to compute. If Python is installed on your computer, PyBLP can be installed with the following command: pip install pyblp Up-to-date documentation for the package is available at https://pyblp.readthedocs.io.
